findings.source_quote: “Probably about 50.” Adrianna glanced lazily at the thermometer. “Hey, it’s 65 degrees! Mom, may we eat lunch outside?”
findings.suggested_fix:
Restore the original numeric values from the authoritative English: Translate as something that preserves “Probably about 50.” and “Hey, it’s 65 degrees!” (do not convert or change the numbers). Keep the same punctuation and sentence breaks inside the same

element.

findings.location: …She snapped the paddle together, hopped into the seat, and pushed the kayak onto the smooth surface of the water.…
findings.source_quote: She snapped the paddle together, hopped into the seat, and pushed the kayak onto the smooth surface of the water.
findings.suggested_fix:
Use the correct Greek word for 'paddle' (κουπί / κουπί/κουπιά) and render the action clearly. For example: «Σφίγγοντας/συναρμολογώντας το κουπί, κάθισε στη θέση του και έσπρωξε το κανό στην ήρεμη επιφάνεια της λίμνης.» Keep this inside the same

tag and preserve surrounding punctuation and order.
findings.translation_quote: Σύνδεσε την κουπαστή, κάθισε στη θέση και πέταξε το κανό πάνω στην ήρεμη επιφάνεια του νερού.
